title: codemother's proofs read the librarian's nodes through the trees client, not its tables
intention: Every codemother proof that checks a deposited node reads it through the librarian's published trees client (trees.read_node, trees.already_held), never through store.read(trees.NODES_TABLE, ...); a leaf-table read passes the node address as text.
why: Measured 2026-11-14: eight codemother proofs read trees.NODES_TABLE by node_id or content through store directly. That is the librarian's internals (RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1.2 publishes the trees client, 4.4.2 the boundary). Under 06db the table is renamed cairn_mem_nodes and node_id becomes an int address, so every one of them breaks the day 06db lands.
traces_to: RULE 1 — encapsulation: a component talks to another only through its public interface.
how: Repoint each read: a by-node_id read of NODES_TABLE becomes trees.read_node(node_id), asserting the view is DATA and its content/provenance/standing; a by-content read becomes trees.already_held(content, conn=store.connect()) asserting None or not None; orient's own-leaf-table read passes str(node_id). Fix verdict.py's docstring that calls node_id_for a content hash. Stacked on 06db (branch ticket-06db-row-ids); lands in the same act as 06db, d32faaf16223 and T5.

clauses.claim: no file under cairn/devices/codemother/ names trees.NODES_TABLE or reads the librarian's node table through store (grep census returns nothing)
the six chart proofs (survey, validate, decompose, constrain, triage, hypothesize) run green on the 06db stack, each checking its deposit through trees.read_node
test_deposit runs green on the 06db stack, its presence/absence checks going through trees.already_held
test_orient_deposits_into_the_tree runs green on the 06db stack, its leaf read passing str(node_id)

no code or proof file names migrate_learning_to_own_tables (only history and the 2b3d842bc118 ticket may), and test_codemother_learning_lands_in_its_own_tables runs green with its migration tooth (tooth_3, PROVES['2b3d842bc118']['3']) retired and clauses 1, 2 and 4-6 kept

decisions.text: D1: the six chart proofs replace store.read(trees.NODES_TABLE, where node_id) with trees.read_node(r['node_id']) and assert state DATA, content, provenance source, standing hypothesis.
D2: test_deposit's node reads (lines 195, 234, 305) become trees.read_node; its content reads (239, 387) become trees.already_held.
D3: orient's proof reads its node through trees.read_node (confidence from provenance) and its own leaf table with str(node_id).
D4: verdict.py's docstring stops calling node_id_for a content hash; same content lands on the same node through the dedup seam.

D5: delete cairn/devices/codemother/migrate_learning_to_own_tables.py, spent: measured on the Dell's live db 2026-11-14, no chart_<n>_nodes source remains and all 9 codemother_<n>_nodes hold rows, so a run changes nothing. In cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_learning_lands_in_its_own_tables.py retire tooth_3 (clause_3_the_migration_moves_and_refuses_a_mismatch) and PROVES['2b3d842bc118']['3']; clauses 1, 2, 4-6 stay. Its validation is resealed at the group act.

measured.saw: 8 codemother files read trees.NODES_TABLE through store: 6 chart proofs (one read each), test_deposit (5 reads: 3 by node_id, 2 by content), orient (1 node read + 1 own-leaf read with an int param against the text node_id column)
